blocks.text: Open-source, self-hostable alternative to Heroku and Vercel

Coolify brings the deployment experience of Vercel and Heroku to your own servers. Install it on any VPS, connect your GitHub repos, and deploy applications with the same git-push workflow - but on infrastructure you own and control, at a fraction of the cost.

For teams paying hundreds of dollars per month on platform-as-a-service providers, Coolify offers dramatic cost savings. A $20/month VPS can host multiple applications, databases, and services that would cost ten times that on managed platforms. The trade-off is that you manage the server.

Coolify handles the operational aspects that make self-hosting practical: automatic SSL certificates, Docker-based deployments, backup management, and server monitoring. You maintain the server; Coolify manages the deployment pipeline.
Deploy on any VPS - DigitalOcean, Hetzner, AWS, etc.
Push-to-deploy from GitHub, GitLab, and Bitbucket
Deploy databases, Redis, and 100+ services instantly
Deploy any Dockerfile or Docker Compose project
Automated database backups to S3-compatible storage

Coolify is our recommendation for teams that want to reduce hosting costs without giving up developer experience. For applications that do not need edge deployment, self-hosting with Coolify can save thousands per year.
Our engineers work with Coolify daily and can help you integrate it into your stack.
